features.name: Four regional origins

features.name: Dooming Spite ability

features.name: Curated mechanical rules and tables

features.name: Night Goblin Net

features.name: Mine enterprises, hirelings, live smuggling and magical rewards
features.reason: No campaign/enterprise/hiring manager, mask bonuses or automatically granted boons.
